(Plazoleta San Pedro Plaza)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="500" width="340" x="50" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_pwa" parent="node_cli" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2563EB;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>PWA Visitante (Browser)</b><hr>• UI Mobile-First Responsive<br>• Service Worker (Cache offline)<br>• LocalStorage (JWT Bearer Token)<br>• Canvas QR & Reloj Regresivo 2h" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="280" x="30" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_pos" parent="node_cli" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#2563EB;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Terminal POS Caja Web</b><hr>• Lector Óptico QR / Escáner POS<br>• Teclado Contingencia Alfanumérica<br>• Interfaz de Confirmación Atómica" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="280" x="30" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_app" parent="1" style="shape=cube;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;darkOpacity=0.05;darkOpacity2=0.1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#1D4ED8;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;size=15;" value="«executionEnvironment»
<b>Nodo 2: Servidor de Aplicación VPS</b>
(Linux Ubuntu 22.04 LTS · 4 vCPU, 8 GB)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="500" width="380" x="490" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_nginx" parent="node_app" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#1D4ED8;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Reverse Proxy Nginx 1.24+</b><hr>• SSL/TLS Termination (HTTPS 443)<br>• DoS Shield (Rate Limit 30 req/s)<br>• Compresión Gzip & CORS Guard" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="320" x="30" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_backend" parent="node_app" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#1D4ED8;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Contenedor Docker: Backend NestJS</b><hr>• Runtime Node.js 20+ LTS (Port 3000)<br>• Módulos Auth, Catalogo, Cupones, POS<br>• CanjeCuponFacade & Token HMAC<br>• Servidor WebSockets WSS Notificaciones" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="320" x="30" y="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_redis" parent="node_app" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#DC2626;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Contenedor Docker: Redis 7.0</b><hr>• In-Memory Cache (TCP 6379 interno)<br>• Cache de Catálogo & Franjas (RNF-01)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="320" x="30" y="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_db" parent="1" style="shape=cube;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;darkOpacity=0.05;darkOpacity2=0.1;fillColor=#FEF2F2;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;size=15;" value="«executionEnvironment»
<b>Nodo 3: Servidor de Persistencia VPC</b>
(Red Privada Aislada · SSD NVMe)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="500" width="340" x="970" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_postgres" parent="node_db" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Motor PostgreSQL 15+ Enterprise</b><hr>• Puerto TCP 5432 (Solo red privada)<br>• Transacciones ACID con Row-Locking<br>• SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (RNF-03)<br>• Tablas en 3FN & Bitácora Inmutable" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="280" x="30" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="art_backup" parent="node_db" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B91C1C;fontSize=10;" value="«artifact»<br><b>Agente Cron de Copias de Seguridad</b><hr>• Respaldo automático diario (3:00 am)<br>• Retención rotativa de 30 días<br>• Copia cifrada externa a Bucket S3" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="280" x="30" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_cli_app" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_cli" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" target="node_app" value="HTTPS 443 / TLS 1.3 (REST)
WSS 443 (WebSockets)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_app_db" edge="1" parent="1" source="node_app" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeColor=#B91C1C;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;" target="node_db" value="TCP 5432 / SSL Nativo
(Red Interna Privada VPC)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
